title: Multi-Process Parts Implementation Plan
summary: Implementation plan adding a kind discriminator (sheet_metal | printed | purchased) to Fabware parts with per-kind DSLs, validators, agent tools, UI, and exporters.
notes: Hybrid implementation plan: PRD-like goals/non-goals/acceptance test plus SPEC-like schema, DSL shapes, function signatures, and per-kind validators. Resolved to SPEC per ambiguity rule (SPEC > PRD) given the dominant technical-contract content (data model + APIs + file-level edits). No frontmatter; no Decision/Consequences sections, so not ADR.
